requiredFiles.description: Vercel URL for the frontend (API URL can be in README)

criteria: JWT authentication is implemented: register and login endpoints exist, and successful login returns a token stored in localStorage or a cookie
At least one protected API endpoint requires a valid JWT — requests without a valid token receive a 401 response
Both user roles defined in the project constraints are implemented: the frontend shows meaningfully different UI elements, not just a label change
No mock data files are used — all data comes from real API calls to the Express backend connected to MongoDB
CORS is configured on the backend to allow requests from the frontend's domain
